material_model: NONE; reuse the exact finite diagnostic world generator from 063-v1
comparator_selection: Fixed here, no new winner selection or hyperparameter tuning
pair_selection: Enumerate feasible unique-source singletons and unordered pairs. Maximize exact expected terminal Bayes-risk reduction divided by the total listed experiment cost. Pair cost must fit remaining budget; pairs also require at least two remaining execution steps. Lexicographic experiment-ID tuple tie break. Execute only the first experiment and replan. Stop on non-positive score. This is nonadaptive pair lookahead with receding-horizon execution, not full adaptive Bellman optimization or global optimality.
pair_likelihood: Product conditional on the declared group hypothesis; independent groups factorize. Known source aliases never form an independent pair. State-independent null labels may be aggregated for scoring only; execution keeps individual labels.
shared_runner_guards: blocked sources excluded even if never observed
real stop reason at step limit
guard_comparison: All seven policies use the same guarded runner. Verify legacy policy endpoints on clean smoke worlds match original unguarded runner. Do not rewrite the archived v1 implementation or result files.
acceptance: Positive bounded primary result only when comparator loss minus pair loss has a 95% interval strictly above zero, observed pair wrong-definitive count is no higher, and all replay/receipt/budget/ledger gates pass. Secondary comparison is descriptive. Otherwise mixed/null/negative/integrity-failed; never require policy victory in CI.
required_controls: perfect XOR sensor plus independent fault audit has zero one-step value but positive joint value
general unnormalized pair scoring matches full posterior enumeration
pair can lose under global budget; no optimality claim
pair infeasible under cost or step cap
legacy baseline endpoints unchanged on clean fixtures
limitations: Review performed by the same assistant with fresh tests, not external independent replication
Known model family and known source-dependence groups
No hidden omitted-law or regime-shift evaluation batch
No physical material dynamics or laboratory hardware
Two-step pair search may waste a first step when replanning and has greater computation cost
